board: CJMCU-811 CCS811 air quality sensor module (8-pin: VCC, GND, SCL, SDA, WAK, INT, RST, ADD)
reason: The check passed on its first run, on both esp32 and pico. The sim answers HW_ID 0x81, STATUS 0x98 and an 8-byte ALG_RESULT_DATA reply (eCO2 ppm, TVOC ppb, STATUS, ERROR_ID, RAW) laid out as in the datasheet, and the datasheet-based driver decodes it. Limitation: STATUS is fixed at application mode with data ready, so the sim never runs the boot-mode APP_START step.
breakoutPinoutSource: https://web.archive.org/web/2025/https://revspace.nl/CJMCU-811 (header order VCC GND SCL SDA WAK INT RST ADD, no regulator, ADD 10k pull-down = 0x5A); confirmed by http://lamaplc.com/doku.php?id=sensor%3Accs811
